fit_decision.question: Is 31 cells at 4-digit counts a realistic fit failure (major) or acceptable (minor)?
fit_decision.measurements: fr first exceeds maxCells 30 at count 1000 (31 cells) and stays 31 through 9999; 29 cells at 999; 33 at 100000; 38 at 1000000. English never exceeds 30 up to 1500000 (29 at 10^6). header_counts breaches its 40-cell budget at 10^6 in BOTH locales (fr 44, en 43).
fit_decision.reasoning: No 1-3 digit count overflows and the overshoot is one cell; the affected segment is appended to a Text(no_wrap=False) meta line in the pinned notifications_render.py, so the consequence is a wrap inside a wrapping pane, not a cropped column or a lost label; and repeat_count reaching 1000 requires 1000 keyed updates to one item (HISTORY_CAP=20 caps history rows only; NEW_ITEMS_PER_HOUR=30 caps new items only). The fr value is byte-identical to the already-audited desktop string ui.notifications.detail.meta.updates_since.
fit_decision.would_change_if: a breach at 3-digit counts, a non-wrapping or cropped container for the meta line, or evidence that repeat_count reaches 1000 in operator use.
